verdict.rationale: Bulk actions across many cases or candidates are a fair ask for an immigration case-management platform serving enterprise hiring teams, so the axis applies. However, the evidence describes only per-case guided intake, evidence organization and attorney review, with no batch or multi-item operations. The probes also found no API or OpenAPI spec through which bulk operations could be run.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
